title: 完整人工智能超级课程2026：从基础到企业AI
summary: 一个涵盖AI全栈学习路径的开源课程仓库，从Python、数学、机器学习、深度学习，到Transformer与LLM、提示工程、RAG、Agent、MCP、多模态、评估与安全及MLOps，最终以综合项目收尾。
summary_en: An open-source curriculum repository covering a full AI learning path: Python, math, ML, deep learning, Transformers & LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, agents, MCP, multimodal AI, evaluation & security, and MLOps, ending with a capstone.
